title: fix(docs): show missing agent and model request fields
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The Markdown API reference now shows request fields for POST /account/agents, /account/my-models, and /account/my-models/test, whose alternative payload schemas previously produced empty request-body sections. Shared fields appear once; each alternative lists its own fields and required markers, with labels drawn from type or modality values. The news pipeline excludes alternative request bodies from API-change detection so documentation formatting does not generate false API-change announcements.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a warm cream background.
